## Summary

Describe the change, the problem it addresses, and the evidence supporting it.

## Checklist

- [ ] I have stated whether `SKILL.md` changed and described any change.
- [ ] User constraints and final invariants have not been silently weakened.
- [ ] Experimental, historical, prospective, and authoritative claims remain distinct; no claim has been strengthened beyond its evidence or collapsed into another claim.
- [ ] Relevant failed candidates, counterevidence, and rollback history are preserved.
- [ ] Strategy or controller promotion claims have objective or held-out tests, or this change makes no such claims.
- [ ] BP2 is not inferred from BP1, BV2 from visual plausibility, or RL3 from prompting or memory.
- [ ] `SKILL.md` remains procedural and concise; detailed domain material belongs in `references/`.
- [ ] `agents/openai.yaml` and `agents/anthropic.yaml` are updated if the skill's user-facing identity changed.
- [ ] Primary-source hashes are preserved, or an intentional source version change and its prior identity are documented.
- [ ] The before-publishing checklist in `CONTRIBUTING.md` is complete; missing evidence or unrun checks are stated below.

## Validation and limitations

Record the checks actually run, their results, and any properties that remain unverifiable.
